This looks like a small-city downtown street, possibly Matsumoto, Nagano, or Morioka. Of the listed cities, Niigata is the closest to Matsumoto. Sendai is the closest to Morioka. The "MAX Factor" sign and the stone-paved street suggest Matsumoto (Nakamachi or Nawate area). Niigata is about 150 km from Matsumoto, and Nagoya about 170 km. Tokyo is about 200 km away. Niigata is the closest, though only narrowly.

If it is Morioka, Sendai would be the answer. The street with mixed stone paving and old brick buildings feels like Morioka as well. I'll go with Matsumoto, so Niigata.
